passages.note: Bill restricts firearm advertising/marketing to minors; the ladder's rungs differ on ownership bans, weapon-type bans, background checks, and carry rules, none of which this instrument touches.

rows.reasoning: AB 2571 prohibits firearm industry members from advertising or marketing firearm-related products in a manner attractive to minors. This regulates marketing practices, not civilian ownership, weapon types, background checks, or carry permits, which is the dimension the gun-policy rungs separate, so the passage is adjacent and off-axis to the ladder and cannot establish a chair.
